description:
Get full detail and LIVE status for one TaskMarket task by ID. Public and anonymous. Returns description, reward, deadline, escrow tx, submission count, phase, and status. Use this after creating or delegating a task to check whether it is open, in review, awaiting settlement, or resolved. Never spends anything.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.
name: taskmarket_get
